lines.en: I sweep my tail and push the water aside.
I swim close to the bottom, slowly.
I skirt the far side of a sunken rock.
I swim toward deeper water.
My bony head plate is heavy.
I push through the weeds with my armored head.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，看水面上的影子。
lines.en: I lift my head at the shadow on the surface.
When I turn, the current turns with me.
I patrol along the rock wall.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地往上浮，又沉下。
lines.en: I rise slowly, then sink.
I go from shadow to shadow.

lines.zh: 我在水底留下浅浅的痕。
lines.en: I leave faint marks on the bottom.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴一甩，能游很远。
lines.en: One stroke of my tail carries me far.

lines.zh: 我游过一群鱼，它们散开。
lines.en: I pass a school of fish, and they scatter.

lines.zh: 我朝那片海草的方向去。
lines.en: I head for that patch of seagrass.

lines.zh: 我在水里很稳，陆地上不行。
lines.en: I'm steady in water, not on land.

lines.zh: 我抬头，光从上面漏下来。
lines.en: I look up; light leaks down.
I ride the current through a whole stretch.

lines.zh: 我停在水层里，一动不动。
lines.en: I hang in the water, perfectly still.

lines.zh: 我张开骨颌，又慢慢咬合。
lines.en: I open my bony jaws and slowly close them.
My teeth are one bone plate.
I hear every stir on the bottom.

lines.zh: 我的头甲上有一道旧痕。
lines.en: There's an old scar on my head plate.
I wait for something to swim close.

lines.zh: 我吐了一口气，几个泡上去。
lines.en: I breathe out; bubbles rise.
I rest against the rock wall.

lines.zh: 我慢慢摆尾巴，保持位置。
lines.en: I sway my tail to hold position.
I remember the black of deep water.
I tilt my body slightly.
I'm in no hurry; things here move slow.
I hear oars above.
My jaws close loudly.

lines.zh: 隔着水，我把你看得清楚。
lines.en: Through the water, I see you clearly.

lines.zh: 你脚一沾水，我就知道了。
lines.en: The moment your foot touches water, I know.

lines.zh: 我仰着头，盯住水面上的你。
lines.en: I tilt up and fix on you above the surface.
The armor on you, I can bite through.
My mouth is wide; look closely.
You swim slower than I do.
The fish near you have fled.

lines.zh: 我在水底认出了你的影子。
lines.en: I make out your shadow on the riverbed.

lines.zh: 我朝你那边偏了一点点。
lines.en: I angle a little your way.

lines.zh: 你听见我咬合的声音了吗？
lines.en: Did you hear my jaws close?

lines.zh: 我的头甲上多了一道痕。
lines.en: Another mark on my head plate.
I retreat into deeper water.
I roll once and steady.
The blow turns me half sideways.
I shake my head, and the water clouds.
I make no sound; nothing to hear down here.
I snap once; my jaws still line up.
I sink to the bottom and rest.
A small tear opens along the edge of my fin.
My fins can still move.

lines.zh: 有东西在水里动，我嗅到了。
lines.en: Something moves in the water; I smell it.

lines.zh: 你抛下来的那块，我看到了。
lines.en: That piece you dropped; I saw it.
The smell of blood, strong.
I swim a little that way.
What you hold is dripping.

lines.zh: 水面上晃的那点，我锁住了。
lines.en: That wobble on the surface—I've locked on.
I hear that struggling.
I open my jaw at it, testing.
Swim closer; I'd rather not chase.
That smell pulls me forward.
You hit my head plate; it's hard.
I turn and shove you with my flank.
We collide, and the water churns.
One tail stroke sweeps past your legs.
You stand on the bottom; I circle past.
I'm knocked off line and steady.
You push my head; it won't move.
When we part, the water is cloudy.
My flank brushes your leg.
One touch, and I turn.
Another swims out of the dark.
Her head plate is narrower.
We swim side by side, slowly.
Her head plate is longer than mine.

lines.zh: 我们一起绕着一块石头。
lines.en: We circle a stone together.
There's a chip in her jaw plate.
We head for the same deep water.
I know the rhythm of her tail.

lines.zh: 我们贴着水底游了很久。
lines.en: We swim the bottom for a long while.
Two shadows, one stretch of deep.

lines.zh: 我咬住一块骨头，咬碎了。
lines.en: I bite a bone and crush it.
I drag your anchor into the deep.

lines.zh: 我吞下一块沉石，又吐了。
lines.en: I swallow a sunken stone and spit it out.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的渔网，扯破了。
lines.en: I bite your net and tear it.

lines.zh: 我把你掉的刀含在嘴里。
lines.en: I hold your dropped knife in my jaws.
I drag off a wreck's remains.
I bite the weeds and drag them.
I hold an egg in my jaws.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的靴子，甩了两下。
lines.en: I bite your boot and shake it twice.

lines.zh: 我把沉在底下的东西翻出来。
lines.en: I turn up what lies on the bottom.
Something moved in the water; I saw it.
I raise my head, locked above.
My jaws are beginning to open.
You wear armor; perfect.
This distance gives me one rush.
That guardian smell; I know it.
I sweep my tail your way.
The shore's too shallow—I can still reach you.
I slip beneath you first.
I've taken the deeper side.

lines.zh: 我在你下方游，慢慢靠近。
lines.en: I swim below you, closing in.

lines.zh: 我的身体和水一个颜色。
lines.en: My body is the water's color.
You swim up; I rise too.
I aim my jaws at your legs.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴一下一下推我。
lines.en: My tail drives me stroke by stroke.
You look back; I'm a little deeper.
I wait at the rock's edge.
You took a breath; I know.
Half a circle more and I'm close.
You've put your back to the wall.
I lunge, and my jaws snap shut.
The suction pulls you in.
I bite its armor, and it breaks.
I ram with my head plate.
I bite into the shell and twist hard.
This bite sinks into its plate.
It breaks free; I circle back and bite.

lines.zh: 水流被我一吸，全往嘴里走。
lines.en: I draw the water in with everything in it.

lines.zh: 它往后缩，我摆尾追上去。
lines.en: It shrinks back; I sweep my tail and follow.
I drag it into the deep.
I rise from the bottom, slowly.
The egg hatched underwater.
This deep water suits me.
I can't see my surroundings yet.
The slime brought me back to the water.
My jaws move first.
One sweep of my tail muddies the riverbed.

lines.zh: 我摆了一下尾巴，游起来。
lines.en: One tail stroke and I'm swimming.
There's light above, far away.
I hear something fall in.
My presence scatters the fish.
My first bite is loud.

lines.zh: 水面上的火照下来，我往下沉。
lines.en: Fire above lights the water; I sink lower.

lines.zh: 我从水里被抛起，摔回水面。
lines.en: I'm thrown up and slap back onto the water.

lines.zh: 我本就在水里，只是喘不上来。
lines.en: I live in water, yet I can't breathe.

lines.zh: 爆炸把水震开，我翻了个身。
lines.en: The blast shoves the water; I roll over.

lines.zh: 一支箭射进水里，插在我背上。
lines.en: An arrow enters the water and sticks in my back.
A light presses on me underwater.

lines.zh: 水里没东西可咬，越来越空。
lines.en: Nothing to bite here; I grow hollow.

lines.zh: 雷打在水面，水里全是麻。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the surface; the water goes numb.

lines.zh: 没有水托着，我沉不下去。
lines.en: With no water to hold me, I can't sink.
